"""Separate algorithm and C2C latency effects in native decode profiles."""

from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

import simpy

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from TokenSim.af.serving.service import AFService
from TokenSim.hardware import HardwareContext
from scripts.lpx.config import with_collective_algorithms
from scripts.lpx.hardware_overrides import communication_hypothesis
from scripts.lpx.native_config import configuration
from scripts.lpx.replay_profiles import extract_profile, source_identity
from scripts.run_lpx_study import study_cases


def measure(hardware, model, layout, variant, mode, pool, queries):
    runtime = configuration(hardware, model, layout, namespace=pool,
                            micro_batch=queries, execution_mode="cuda_graph",
                            graph_kernel_us=.2, ffn_batching=False)
    env = simpy.Environment()
    service = AFService(env, runtime, seed=42, retain_trace=True)
    session = service.admit(0, 0, maximum_context=404400, current_context=404199-queries)
    session.generated = 1
    env.run(until=env.process(service.forward([session], query_tokens=queries)))
    events = service.trace.events
    extract_profile(events, pool, env.now, {})
    lookup = {event.node_id:event for event in events}
    hosts = [event for event in events if event.operation == "cuda_graph_submit"]
    node = max(events, key=lambda event:event.end_at)
    costs = defaultdict(lambda:dict(service_us=0., queue_us=0., gap_us=0., nodes=0))
    while node:
        parents = [lookup[key] for key in node.predecessor_ids]
        if not parents and hosts and node not in hosts:
            parents = hosts
        previous = max(parents,key=lambda event:event.end_at) if parents else None
        row = costs[node.operation]
        row["service_us"] += (node.end_at-node.start_at)*1e6
        row["queue_us"] += (node.start_at-node.ready_at)*1e6
        row["gap_us"] += (node.ready_at-(previous.end_at if previous else 0))*1e6
        row["nodes"] += 1
        node = previous
    assert abs(sum(sum(v[k] for k in ["service_us","queue_us","gap_us"]) for v in costs.values())-env.now*1e6)<1e-6
    algorithms = defaultdict(int)
    for event in events:
        if event.operation in {"all_reduce","all_gather","reduce_scatter"}:
            algorithms[event.details["algorithm"]] += 1
    print(model.model_id,variant,mode,pool,queries,f"{env.now*1e6:.2f} us",flush=True)
    return dict(model=model.model_id,variant=variant,mode=mode,pool=pool,
                context=404199,queries=queries,seed=42,layout=vars(layout),
                duration_us=env.now*1e6,critical_path=costs,algorithms=algorithms,
                native_reconstruction_passed=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    hardware=HardwareContext.load(ROOT/"data")
    rows=[]
    for model_name in ["expert","wide"]:
        model=hardware.models.resolve(f"gpt-oss-2t-{model_name}-proxy")
        _,original=study_cases(model.model_id)
        names=["rubin-tp4-pp2" if model_name=="expert" else "rubin-tp8",
               "af-tp8" if model_name=="expert" else "af-f2-ep128-pp10",
               "pd-compact","draft-lpx256"]
        for variant,latency in [("ring",None),("auto-direct",None),("auto-direct-350ns",.35)]:
            cases=original if variant=="ring" else with_collective_algorithms(original,gpu="auto",lpu="direct")
            context=communication_hypothesis(hardware,latency)
            for name in names:
                case=next(c for c in cases if c.name==name)
                rows.append(measure(context,model,case.decode,variant,case.mode,"target",
                                    5 if case.mode=="draft" else 1))
                if case.draft:
                    draft=hardware.models.resolve("gpt-oss-draft-proxy")
                    rows.append(measure(context,draft,case.draft,variant,case.mode,"draft",1))
    Path(__file__).with_name("native-steps.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(
        schema="tokensim.lpx_literature_native_steps",version=1,
        source_sha256=source_identity(),driver_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        scope="Native single-pass controls, not full-request interactivity or measured hardware. Draft verification commits are not inferred from pass times.",results=rows),indent=2)+"\n")

"""Run paired LPX studies with at most four simulation workers in total."""

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
lock = threading.Lock()
records = []


def run(model, variant, formal):
    expert = model == "expert"
    cases = ["rubin-tp4-pp2" if expert else "rubin-tp8",
             "af-tp8" if expert else "af-f2-ep128-pp10", "pd-compact", "draft-lpx256"]
    name = f"{model}-{variant}"
    command = [sys.executable, "scripts/run_lpx_study.py", "--model",
               f"gpt-oss-2t-{model}-proxy", "--output", str(OUT/name),
               "--cases", *cases, "--users", "1", "4", "--maximum-users", "4",
               "--jobs", "2", "--formal-jobs", "2", "--samples", "16",
               "--phase", "all" if formal else "coarse"]
    if variant != "ring":
        command += ["--gpu-collective-algorithm", "auto", "--lpu-collective-algorithm", "direct"]
    if variant == "auto-direct-350ns":
        command += ["--c2c-latency-us", "0.35"]
    record = dict(name=name, command=command, started=time.time(), state="running",
                  formal=formal, output=str(OUT/name))
    with (OUT/f"{name}.log").open("w") as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        record["pid"] = process.pid
        with lock:
            records.append(record)
            (OUT/"process.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2)+"\n")
        print("START", name, process.pid, flush=True)
        code = process.wait()
    with lock:
        record.update(finished=time.time(), exit_code=code, state="complete" if code==0 else "failed")
        (OUT/"process.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2)+"\n")
    print("DONE", name, code, flush=True)
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    jobs = [(model, variant, formal) for variant, formal in
            [("auto-direct-350ns", True), ("ring", False), ("auto-direct", False)]
            for model in ("expert", "wide")]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        outcomes = list(pool.map(lambda args: run(*args), jobs))
    raise SystemExit(int(any(outcomes)))
